title: British Feet Grew Two Shoe Sizes In 40 Years
hook: Modern shoes are fitting feet that became longer and wider.
closing: Measure before buying because the size you remember may no longer fit your feet.
question: Has your shoe size changed?

segments.say: Average British men's feet grew two shoe sizes. Modern shoppers need a larger fit than the previous generation.
67 percent of British women report wider feet in adulthood. The change affects width as well as length.
66 percent of adults in England are overweight or obese. More body weight helps explain why feet spread.
